findings.item: dashboard_kpi_key in common/caching/keys.py accepts user_id but omits it from the generated key string. Two users at the same restaurant_id:branch_id scope share one cache slot and can receive each other's KPI data. Fix by inserting user_id into the key format and updating the invalidate_dashboard_kpis glob pattern.

performance/locustfile.py and all scenario files are untracked and appear in no commit. The load test infrastructure checklist item (locustfile.py exists, concurrent payment scenario present) cannot be verified against the repository. Commit the performance/ directory.

backend/tests/test_concurrency.py has uncommitted working-tree modifications that add required OrderItem/MenuItem fixtures to ConcurrentBillFinalizationTest. The committed version may fail on model validation. Stage and commit the fix.
ConcurrentStockTransferTest required by FEAT-004 is absent from the committed test suite. Add it to test_concurrency.py.

In get_or_set, when acquired=False and the cache re-read returns None, the non-acquiring caller falls through to compute and write independently. The lock key (owned by the original acquirer) is left in Redis for up to 10 seconds with no cleanup from the non-acquiring writer. The fallback behavior is correct for availability but the lock key lifetime comment should clarify this is by design and TTL-bounded.
